fusions.name: Drag Together
fusions.desc: A raking pull that deals 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Pile
fusions.desc: Drops onto an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 16 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to this blow.

fusions.name: Tidy Sweep
fusions.desc: Removes up to 6 conditions from you. For 5 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Gleaned Strength
fusions.desc: When a condition ends on you, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
